title: sports-salient-viewport output
description: Fit-inside 9:16 viewport for the clip's last frame: float32 [x1, y1, x2, y2, conf]. Bbox corners are normalized to [0, 1] vs 384x224; conf is mean relu'd saliency inside the window (peak_mass / (224*126)).
x-confidence: peak box-sum of relu'd last-frame saliency divided by viewport area (224*126)
